guide.title: Quick guide
guide.subtitle: How to use the platform.

steps.one: Choose an incident type in "Start incident".
steps.two: The AI Inspector starts the process step by step.
steps.three: Check off checklist items as you complete them.
steps.four: Track the required documents and legal basis in the right panel.
steps.five: The case is saved automatically — continue from "My work".

guide.slogan: A reliable AI assistant for every inspector. Every decision — grounded in legislation and approved procedures, every process — step by step.
